_: The King's hosts and their orders (hosts.js; Warcraft III's command card, Total War's campaign map: an army is one thing on the map, ordered as one). near: crown companies within this many tiles of each other (and under no separate order) are one host. speed: tiles a host moves each season on an order. men: men to a company, as the ledger counts them. splitMin: a host needs at least this many companies to split. ships: unit types that are never part of a host.
